pure-announcement.rationale: It is a first-person methodology letter describing a development framework, not a launch, release, or funding note.

duplicate.rationale: acceptability-envelope-evals covers eval design itself, not this three-loop decomposition of agentic product development; no supplied concept covers loop engineering.

unfalsifiable.rationale: It is a primary-source account of the author's own practice, and the central mechanism — closing the inner loop with specs and evals so agents iterate unattended — is directly reproducible.

durability.rationale: The three nested loops with characteristic cadences (agent iteration in minutes, developer steering in hours, external feedback in days) and the reframing of taste as a human context advantage are model-agnostic patterns with nothing version-pinned to rot.

actionability.rationale: It tells a builder where to spend effort — close the inner loop with evals when the agent repeats mistakes, move developer time from QA to product steering, deliberately run slow external-feedback tactics — which reorganises how someone works with coding agents.

atomicity.rationale: The three loops are components of one framework stateable in a paragraph, not separable unrelated ideas.
